hints.title: City Degree Influence
hints.text: Every road contributes the importance of both incident cities. Thus city i contributes importance[i] * degree[i] to the total.

hints.title: Greedy Degree Sorting
hints.text: By rearrangement inequality, assign the highest available importance values (1 to n) to the cities with the highest degrees.

hints.title: Dot Product Computation
hints.text: Sort the degree array ascending, and multiply degree[i] by (i + 1) for i from 0 to n - 1.

hints.title: Sorted Degree Dot Product Implementation

complexity.notes: Tallying degrees takes O(m); sorting degrees takes O(n log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying different importance assignments yields n! permutations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate demonstrates why assigning higher weights to higher-degree nodes maximizes the bilinear form.
